name: Greek Salmon Salad with Tomato, Olives, Yogurt Dressing & Breadsticks

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle oil over flatbread, season with spices, and cut into 1½-inch wide strips; transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 flatbreads or naan
¾ tsp garlic powder
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a plate. Season with spices on the top-side.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg salmon fillet
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add salmon, skin-side down, and cook until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside.
While the salmon is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
3 heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a large bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl with the dill.
Peel and mince shallots. Add to the bowl along with yogurt, water, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp water
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives and add to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Using a fork or your hands, flake the salmon into bite-sized pieces.
Divide salad between plates or bowls and top with salmon. Serve with breadsticks on the side and enjoy!
